caption: The drawing features a lattice structure composed of multiple wooden strips, colored brown with visible wood grain texture. The strips are arranged in a criss-cross or X-shaped pattern, overlapping each other at regular angles and joined at their intersections by circular metal fasteners, depicted as silver or grayish round rivets. The lattice is framed horizontally near the bottom by two thicker rectangular wooden bars, each also fastened with similar metal rivets at every intersection with the vertical members. The drawing is set on a cream-colored background and outlined with a thin pencil or ink border. In the upper left corner, there is a small, labeled technical diagram indicating the dimensions and proportions of the structure; it is drawn in fine black lines and annotated with numbers suggesting measurements in inches and feet. The main section of the drawing is rendered in shaded and colored pencil, giving a three-dimensional appearance to the individual wooden components, while the small technical diagram is uncolored. A signature reading “James N. Lawson” along with a date is visible in the lower right corner of the page.
title: Comb and Brush Rack
